description: This Java interface defines a repository for accessing LoanCapitalizedIncomeBalance entities, including custom queries for retrieving balances, calculations, and related transaction data within the Fineract loan portfolio module.

classes.name: LoanCapitalizedIncomeBalanceRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for LoanCapitalizedIncomeBalance with custom query methods for balance and transaction data.

methods.name: findAllByLoanIdAndClosedFalse
methods.description: Retrieves all non-closed, non-deleted balances for a specific loan.

methods.name: findAllByLoanIdAndDeletedFalseAndClosedFalse
methods.description: Retrieves all non-closed, non-deleted balances for a specific loan.

methods.name: findByLoanIdAndLoanTransactionIdAndDeletedFalseAndClosedFalse
methods.description: Finds a specific balance by loan ID and transaction ID, ensuring it is not deleted or closed.

methods.name: findRepaymentPeriodDataByLoanId
methods.description: Retrieves repayment period data for a specific loan.

methods.name: calculateCapitalizedIncome
methods.description: Calculates total capitalized income for a loan.

methods.name: calculateCapitalizedIncomeAdjustment
methods.description: Calculates total capitalized income adjustment for a loan.

methods.name: findBalanceForAdjustment
methods.description: Finds the balance for a specific transaction to be used for adjustment.

methods.name: findBaseTransactionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves base transaction info for amortization allocation related to a specific loan transaction.
